overview: The source partition is finite and internally consistent, and the proposal honestly leaves actual target roster, whole58 qualification and signing authority open. The runner is not yet suitable for freezing an executable Root literal: its total/cleanup deadline is incomplete, W14 toolchain-root cannot satisfy its file-only resource API, and pinned documents are not consumed as actual Root execution authority.

important_findings.description: The total deadline is checked only before a child launch, but run_one always receives the full per_invocation_wall_seconds. A launch near the total deadline may consume that full budget, plus process.wait(10), two joins(10), final receipt/report IO. The total clock also starts only after scope/resource/source rehashing. No final deadline check exists. Timeout/kill/wait/drain/parsing/IO exceptions can bypass the aggregate report; non-daemon drain threads can remain live after DRAIN_INCOMPLETE. The receipt has flags but no immutable first-cause/secondary ordering.
important_findings.specific_fix: Use one monotonic deadline covering the agreed complete phase, pass min(per-invocation, remaining minus explicit finalization/cleanup/IO reserve), and reject before launch if the usable remainder is nonpositive. Bound wait/join and final IO by remaining time, with the separately reviewed outer Job responsible for actual descendant termination and pipe closure. Preserve the first observed cause and append secondary failures in try/finally; always leave a complete or explicitly partial aggregate/child receipt with original raw paths/hash availability and true nullable native exit. Do not pretend raw hashes are complete when a writer is still alive. Recheck the absolute deadline after final writes before successful return.
minimum_NOT_RUN_controls: Near-deadline list and lane launch gets only remaining budget or is refused
Timeout with inherited child stdout handles terminates within outer bound and retains first cause
Overflow/drain/kill/wait/final-IO failures retain partial raw and aggregate facts
Final report IO crossing deadline cannot return success
Missing native termination remains NULL; no retry or counter reset

important_findings.description: Every runtime.members row is passed through pinned_file, which accepts only a regular file. The W14_GO_TOOLCHAIN environment path must then exactly equal one of those rows. The actual TestRuntimeCheckNativeGo consumes W14_GO_TOOLCHAIN as a toolchain_root directory, recursively hashed by FrozenGoToolchainHash/checkTree and put into policy.toolchain_root. A real directory fails pinned_file; using go.exe passes the runner path predicate but fails the actual tree contract. Omitting it causes the real probe to skip and is proactively rejected for the native lane. This is a legitimate-positive-path ABI failure, not missing resource evidence.
important_findings.specific_fix: Keep Node and Mu bundle as file pins, but model W14 Go root separately as a typed canonical directory/complete tree manifest. Bind that root and its executable/tree/build hashes to the reviewed runtime catalog, frozen Go policy and environment. Verify exact membership and path containment/reparse rules for the directory without widening file-only member authorization. An arbitrary parent directory or a lone go.exe must not substitute for the toolchain tree.
minimum_NOT_RUN_controls: Actual canonical frozen Go root directory passes the scope and real test ABI
A lone executable cannot substitute for toolchain_root
Missing/changed/extra tree membership, foreign root or reparse root rejected
Omitting W14 records SKIP/unqualified rather than succeeding as whole-suite

important_findings.description: validate_scope trusts execution_authorized=True and hashes eleven referenced files without reading their registration/grant/current-authority/lease/source/outer-cap semantics. Those hashes do not prove an actual grant or active meter. The sibling CONTRACT is loaded without a scope-bound SHA/bytes check; main checks only package count58 and top-test count745, so altered import_arg/regex/lane membership can direct executions outside the reviewed finite plan. Environment/cache/temp/output and the exact selected calls are not bound to the registered grant here. The nineteen NULL fields in the proposal are honestly unadopted, but supplying files or a true literal is insufficient to close this execution interface.
important_findings.specific_fix: Before any Popen, consume an actual typed Root authorization gate, or a separately implemented/reviewed Root wrapper whose validated receipt is required and exactly bound to this scope. It must bind runner+contract+MF hashes, current e2ee22a source/current canonical state/lease/unique run roots, non-author review and real registered grant, selected finite packages/lanes/test IDs/argv/environment/runtime directory/file closures, actual outer Job/process/HTTP controls and explicit budgets. Pin the exact contract bytes and enforce the reviewed import args/regex/coverage; preserve all unknown authority/control facts as OPEN. Separate run authority from source_acceptance so no source-acceptance-before-testing cycle is introduced.
minimum_NOT_RUN_controls: Real Root registration/review/grant/current source/lease with exact contract is statically composable
Arbitrary hashed documents and self-declared authorized=True cannot authorize a launch
Changed contract import_arg/regex/selected lane or stale grant denied before launch
Unreviewed cache/temp/PATH/output roots and missing outer meter denied
Model requests remain separately blocked on B01; local scope cannot inherit model or whole58 acceptance

suggestions.description: Strengthen Go JSON validation with the frozen actual import-path identity, exactly one terminal per top test, all fail/skip/subtest failures rejected, and malformed/foreign/duplicate events fail closed. terminal[name]=action currently overwrites duplicates and package_pass accepts any package. The reviewed source has no duplicate top names per directory; these are NOT_RUN corruption controls, not observed native failures.

Represent packages with no selected lane as NOT_APPLICABLE and include planned-versus-actual invocation/test counts. all([]) currently allows aggregate exit0 for unselected packages; that can be legitimate selected-lane completion, but must not be labelled full-package testing. The report already keeps qualified=false, so no actual whole58 PASS is asserted.

Preserve the honest actual_source_acceptance_consumer=NULL boundary. Root must designate and review the exact immutable owner receipt plus independent verifier consumer/schema in a new scope; this is a required future interface, not a currently established signer.

verified_static_facts.init_direct_operations: Map registration/assignment and strings.Fields loops; cli_contract init calls registeredHere. This does not verify every dependent package initializer, top-level initializer, generated code or transitive effect.
verified_static_facts.static_callgraph_proof_limit: 3661 functions/32074 name edges and 8-hop/512-node caps are lexical leads only. Same-package unique-name dispatch omits receiver/interface/cross-package semantics. 272 of the purported no-signal lane graphs are capped. Lane labels cannot prove no SDK or foreign effects.
verified_static_facts.build_only_semantics: 31 directories use ^$ and require compile/package exit with no selected/terminal tests; this is not a test PASS. Non-build lanes require exact selected top names, reject actual SKIP, and use -count=1/exact top regex.
verified_static_facts.cleanup_scope: Runner creates output directories and exclusive raw files; it performs no recursive removal. Root must freeze owned temp/cache/output roots and safe cleanup in the real controller; no cleanup authority is adopted here.

Root_required_slices.inputs: New literal scope and independent review of runner+contract+manifest, real registered grant/current canonical+source+lease, unique phase/output/cache/temp allocation and actual outer Job binding; none is authorized by this review.

Separate controlled fresh actual Windows Go env/module/dependency/import/build-input graph and -list roster for all58, including31 build-only and60 source clauses. go test -list executes test-binary init/TestMain, so it is a product/native stage that needs prior Root authority, resources and meters, not harmless census IO.

Exact pinned Go executable plus W14 directory tree, standard-library/compiler/module/cache/embedded/dependency closure, Node executable/Mu bundle and any local tools; actual runtime identities and complete membership. Static graph/init review does not replace these.

Numerical per-invocation and absolute total wall, explicit finalization/cleanup/IO reserve, stdout/stderr caps, total and concurrent primary/nested process counts, local HTTP cap plus foreign/provider deny/meter and controlled roots. max_child_processes=1 only describes one primary child at a time; Go compiler/test descendants require their own actual bound.

Execute only explicitly granted local lane slices once, preserve all native/raw/timeout/overflow/skip/first-cause/secondary facts and compare exact expected-versus-observed package/test/selector coverage. Exit0 for a selected slice or build-only stage is not whole58 qualification.

The two REAL_MODEL_B01_HOLD tests and all unknown cross-package provider attempts need their own strict B01 monetary/resource/SDK authority; model request/cost dimensions remain NULL until proved. Other fixtures may progress independently, but cannot imply no provider effects from static labels.

After actual evidence, freeze the source58 receipt schema/consumer and legitimate W05 owner execution receipt with distinct authenticated independent verifier. Existing step-state fields executor_id/verifier_id/evidence are structural registration fields; task_packet list/show/next and old source_acceptance=false receipts are not source acceptance.

source_signer_boundary.legitimate_future_owner: W05 owner executor receipt under a new Root registered scope, with an actual distinct non-author independent verifier whose acceptance is consumed by an explicitly frozen schema/consumer.
source_signer_boundary.task_packet_role: read-only list/show/next; identity-field validation does not authenticate identity or sign code
source_signer_boundary.formal_relation: Go-suite and Desktop/CLI development qualification may support a future source receipt; each of 42 frozen formal cases still requires its separate GLOBAL_EVIDENCE_V1/independent acceptance. Neither source preparation nor metadata fixes increment formal acceptance.

what_is_done_well: All 745 source tests are assigned once and all58 packages are explicit, including31 build-only packages.
The static graph and all nineteen future Root fields state their limitations; no actual target roster, signing consumer or qualification is invented.
The runner uses exact escaped top-test selectors, fresh -count=1, exclusive raw files and rejects actual skip/timeout/output overflow.
The real-model lane is not an allowed local selection and model_cost_usd stays NULL.
Original failure counters and prior false source-signing sinks are preserved.
